attributes.name: Helm of Telepathy
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to examine the top card of another character's deck; that character may shuffle his deck.

When you would discard cards as Combat or Mental damage, recharge this card to instead recharge up to two of those cards; you may play another armor.

If proficient with light armors, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.
